title: Ripple campaign timetable and owner rotations for GA feature
creator: Aria Patel
description: Coordinated announcement plan for Feature Gamma GA that minimizes customer confusion and spreads load across channels. Deliver a granular timetable (blog, release notes, staged email waves, social posts, and a customer webinar), a rotation schedule for channel owners during launch week, and a concise runbook for realtime incidents and fallback messaging. Scope excludes paid media and partner co-marketing; those are tracked separately.
acceptance_criteria: Master announcement playbook published to Confluence with clear owner assignments and timestamps
Release notes (short + expanded) drafted, reviewed by engineering and legal, and linked from blog and console changelog
Email wave templates approved and scheduled in ESP for segmented audiences (beta, active, all) with fallback copy for delay scenarios
Social post queue created with assets and timezone posting plan; approvals captured
Customer webinar scheduled with registration page live and internal runbook for Q&A and escalation
rollout_wave_schedule: Wave 0 - Internal & Trusted Partners: 2026-03-16 09:00 PT - internal brief, partners email, private changelog entry
Wave 1 - Early Access Beta cohort: 2026-03-16 13:00 PT - targeted email + in-console banner
Wave 2 - General availability public blog & full release notes: 2026-03-17 08:00 PT - blog posts, public changelog, social blitz (staged)
Wave 3 - Customer webinar + on-demand recording: 2026-03-17 11:00 PT - webinar live, follow-up drip email to registrants
Wave 4 - Reminder & best-practice content: 2026-03-18 10:00 PT - product tips thread, one-pager, examples repo link
